[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                                 [ch]F[/ch]
From the great Atlantic Ocean to the wide Pacific shore,[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]G[/ch]                                                    [ch]C[/ch]
To the green old flow'ring mountains, to the ice-bound Labrador[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                                     [ch]F[/ch]
She's long and tall and handsome and known quite well to all.[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                          [ch]C[/ch]
She's the modern combination called the Wabash Cannonball.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                           [ch]F[/ch]
So listen to the jingle, the jumble and the roar[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]G[/ch]                                                        [ch]C[/ch]
as she glides along the woodlands, through the hills and by the shore.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                                            [ch]F[/ch]
Hear the mighty rush of the engine, and the lonesome hoboes squall,[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                                               [ch]C[/ch]
While riding through the jungle on the Wabash Cannonball.[/tab]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                                [ch]F[/ch]

[tab] [ch]C[/ch]                                                            [ch]F[/ch]

[tab][ch]G[/ch]                                                          [ch]C[/ch]
